newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA DENY NADAL-EMERSON DEAL WITH MIDDLESBROUGH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA DENY NADAL-EMERSON DEAL WITH MIDDLESBROUGH.

text.p: Barcelona have denied press reports suggesting they are close to exchanging defender Miguel Angel Nadal for Middlesbrough's troubled Brazilian midfielder Emerson.
"There's nothing in it," said a source at the club on Thursday.
Barcelona coach Bobby Robson is thought to be interested in Emerson, while Nadal is reportedly unhappy after Barcelona blocked his move to reigning English champions Manchester United.
